lines.text: I prefer remote roles, except when a role offers regular mentoring in Saltmere, before I decide if it suits me.
I like short written updates that say what changed, why and what comes next, without opening other notes, and a small list of roles with clear tasks and regular feedback.
I like garden plans that keep the path by the amber gate in Saltmere clear, and when I plan garden work I do not want tools left on the path.
I want recipe notes to keep each ingredient next to its step and the first amounts, and never guess a new serving size.
I like travel notes that keep the meeting place and the first date, with any weather conditions, and never treat a maybe plan as a booked trip.
I want comparisons that say what is missing, so a choice that is not sure stays not sure until I add the words that settle it.
